get.description:
Returns the merchant's tipping configuration, including the preset tip suggestions.

This API requires **MERCHANT READ** authority.

put.description:
Replaces the merchant's tipping configuration, including the preset tip suggestions.

This API requires **MERCHANT WRITE** authority.

get.description:
Returns the merchant's business information. The merchant must be the one the calling app is authorized for.

This API requires **MERCHANT READ** authority.

parameters.name: merchantId
parameters.description: UUID of the merchant.

put.description:
Updates the merchant's business information (name, address, phone number).

This API requires **MERCHANT WRITE** authority.

parameters.name: merchantId
parameters.description: UUID of the merchant to update.

get.description:
Returns a single inventory item by its UUID.

This API requires **ITEM READ** authority.

parameters.name: itemUuid
parameters.description: UUID of the item.

put.description:
Updates an existing inventory item. The full state is applied: omitted optional fields fall back to their defaults.

This API requires **ITEM WRITE** authority.

parameters.name: itemUuid
parameters.description: UUID of the item to update.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes an inventory item. The item disappears from the register but remains readable via includeDeleted.

This API requires **ITEM WRITE** authority.

parameters.name: itemUuid
parameters.description: UUID of the item to delete.

get.description:
Returns a single discount by its UUID.

This API requires **ITEM READ** authority.

parameters.name: discountId
parameters.description: UUID of the discount.

put.description:
Updates an existing discount.

This API requires **ITEM WRITE** authority.

parameters.name: discountId
parameters.description: UUID of the discount to update.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes a discount so it can no longer be applied.

This API requires **ITEM WRITE** authority.

parameters.name: discountId
parameters.description: UUID of the discount to delete.

get.description:
Returns a single charge by its UUID.

This API requires **ITEM READ** authority.

parameters.description: UUID of the charge.

put.description:
Updates an existing charge.

This API requires **ITEM WRITE** authority.

parameters.description: UUID of the charge to update.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes a charge. It is removed from the items it was applied to.

This API requires **ITEM WRITE** authority.

parameters.name: chargeId
parameters.description: UUID of the charge to delete.

get.description:
Returns a single inventory category by its UUID.

This API requires **ITEM READ** authority.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: UUID of the category.

put.description:
Updates the name of an existing inventory category.

This API requires **ITEM WRITE** authority.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: UUID of the category to update.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes an inventory category. Items keep their other categories.

This API requires **ITEM WRITE** authority.

devNotes.description: Free-form key-value metadata attached to the line item by third-party apps. Not shown to the merchant.

binName.description: Optional identifier (max 200 characters) used to group related line items within an order.

transactionId.description: UUID of the transaction that paid for this line, once paid.

isTaxable.description: Whether taxes apply to this line item.

finalTotalPrice.description: Final total price, in the smallest currency unit, resolved for the payment type used. Present only when computed.

finalTotalDiscount.description: Final total discount, in the smallest currency unit, resolved for the payment type used. Present only when computed.

finalTotalPriceDiscounted.description: Final total price after discounts, in the smallest currency unit, resolved for the payment type used. Present only when computed.

LineItemDto.description: A single line of an order: one inventory item (or ad-hoc entry) with its quantity, prices, discounts, taxes and fees.

orderDiscountId.description: Unique UUID identifier of this order discount application.

discountId.description: UUID of the merchant's discount this application was created from; null for ad-hoc discounts.

discountAmountType.description: How the amount is interpreted: PERCENTAGE (percentage of the order price) or FIXED (absolute amount).

amount.description: Discount value — percentage points (scaled by 100, e.g. 1000 = 10%) for PERCENTAGE discounts, or the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents) for FIXED discounts.

OrderDiscountDto.description: A discount applied to a whole order.

orderId.description: Unique UUID identifier of the order.

customerId.description: UUID of the customer attached to the order, if any.

ebtSubtotal.description: Subtotal of the EBT-eligible portion of the order, in the smallest currency unit; null when no items are EBT-eligible.

discounts.description: Order-level discounts applied to the order.

fee.description: Total fees applied to the order, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

ebtTotal.description: Grand total of the EBT-eligible portion, in the smallest currency unit; null when no items are EBT-eligible.

transactions.description: Payment transactions recorded against the order.

state.description: Lifecycle state of the order (e.g. OPEN, COMPLETED).

tipAmount.description: Tip amount added to the order, in the smallest currency unit; null when no tip.

paymentType.description: How the order was (or is being) paid.

notes.description: Free-form notes attached to the order.

lastModified.description: When the order was last modified (ISO-8601).

isDeleted.description: Whether the order has been soft-deleted. Deleted orders are only returned when explicitly requested via includeDeleted.

finalTax.description: Final tax actually charged, in the smallest currency unit, resolved for the payment type used. Present only when computed.

finalDiscount.description: Final discount actually applied, in the smallest currency unit, resolved for the payment type used. Present only when computed.

finalSubtotal.description: Final subtotal, in the smallest currency unit, resolved for the payment type used. Present only when computed.

finalTotal.description: Final total, in the smallest currency unit, resolved for the payment type used. Present only when computed.

finalTotalWithTips.description: Final total including tips, in the smallest currency unit, resolved for the payment type used. Present only when computed.

OrderDto.description: An order (sale) in CorePOS, including its line items, discounts, totals and payment transactions. Monetary amounts are in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents); dual-priced amounts are cash/card pairs.

transactionId.description: Unique UUID identifier of the transaction.

refNumber.description: Reference number of the transaction as printed on the receipt.

orderId.description: UUID of the order this transaction belongs to, if any.

transactionType.description: Kind of transaction (e.g. SALE, REFUND, VOID).

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used (e.g. CASH, CREDIT, DEBIT, EBT).

amount.description: Amount of the transaction, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

taxAmount.description: Tax portion of the amount, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

cardNumber.description: Masked card number used for the payment, if paid by card.

cardType.description: Card brand used for the payment (e.g. VISA, MASTERCARD), if paid by card.

rawData.description: Raw response data returned by the payment terminal, if any.

takenBy.description: Name of the person who took the payment, if recorded.

entry.description: How the card was entered (e.g. swipe, chip, contactless), if paid by card.

authCode.description: Authorization code returned by the payment processor, if paid by card.

hostRefNumber.description: Reference number assigned by the payment host, if paid by card.

aid.description: EMV application identifier (AID) of the card, if paid by chip card.

appLabel.description: EMV application label of the card, if paid by chip card.

tenderedAmount.description: Amount tendered by the customer, in the smallest currency unit; used for cash payments.

changeAmount.description: Change returned to the customer, in the smallest currency unit; used for cash payments.

refundedTransactionId.description: UUID of the transaction that was refunded by this one, for REFUND transactions.

dualPricingSurchargeApplied.description: Whether a dual-pricing card surcharge was applied to this transaction.

TransactionGetDto.description: A payment transaction recorded in CorePOS (sale, refund, etc.), including the employee who took it. Monetary amounts are in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

code.description: Authorization code received from the authorize step.

clientId.description: Client identifier of the third-party application.

clientSecret.description: Client secret of the third-party application.

OAuthTokensRequestDto.description: Payload for exchanging an authorization code for an access/refresh token pair.

accessToken.description: JWT access token to send as the 'Authorization: Bearer' header on API calls.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token used to obtain a new token pair when the access token expires.

TokensDto.description: An OAuth2 access/refresh token pair issued to a third-party application.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token from the previously issued token pair.

clientId.description: Client identifier of the third-party application.

clientSecret.description: Client secret of the third-party application.

OAuthRefreshTokenDto.description: Payload for refreshing an expired access token.

imagePath.description: Path to the stored full-size image.

thumbPath.description: Path to the stored thumbnail image.

ItemImageDto.description: Paths of an item's stored images after an image upload.

priceType.description: How the item is priced: FIXED (catalog price), VARIABLE (price entered at sale time) or PER_UNIT (price per unit of measure, e.g. per pound).

isEBT.description: Whether the item is eligible for EBT (Electronic Benefit Transfer) payment.

categories.description: UUIDs of existing categories the item belongs to.

items.description: UUIDs of existing categories the item belongs to.

charges.description: UUIDs of existing charges (extra fees) applied to the item.

items.description: UUIDs of existing charges (extra fees) applied to the item.

isChargesDefault.description: Whether the merchant's default charges are applied to the item in addition to the explicitly listed ones.

productCode.description: Product code of the item (e.g. UPC/barcode value).

itemCost.description: The merchant's cost for one unit of the item, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

quantity.description: Deprecated integer stock counter. Use stockQuantity instead.

stockQuantity.description: Initial stock quantity. Supports fractional values for per-unit items (e.g. 2.5 lb).

trackInventory.description: Whether CorePOS tracks stock for this item and decrements it on each sale.

dualPricingBasePriceType.description: Which side of the price pair (CASH or CARD) is the base price; the other side is derived from the dual-pricing rate.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp (ISO-8601). Defaults to the server time when omitted.

lastModified.description: Modification timestamp (ISO-8601). Defaults to the server time when omitted.

isAvailable.description: Whether the item is available for sale on the register immediately after creation.

ThirdPartyItemCreateDto.description: Payload for creating a new inventory item.

amount.description: Discount value — percentage points (scaled by 100, e.g. 1000 = 10%) for PERCENTAGE discounts, or the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents) for FIXED discounts. Must be at least 0.

discountAmountType.description: How the amount is interpreted: PERCENTAGE (percentage of the price) or FIXED (absolute amount).

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp (ISO-8601). Defaults to the server time when omitted.

lastModified.description: Modification timestamp (ISO-8601). Defaults to the server time when omitted.

isActive.description: Whether the discount is active and selectable on the register immediately after creation.

ThirdPartyDiscountCreateDto.description: Payload for creating a new discount.

discountId.description: Unique UUID identifier of the discount.

amount.description: Discount value — percentage points (scaled by 100, e.g. 1000 = 10%) for PERCENTAGE discounts, or the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents) for FIXED discounts.

discountAmountType.description: How the amount is interpreted: PERCENTAGE (percentage of the price) or FIXED (absolute amount).

isActive.description: Whether the discount is currently active and selectable on the register.

lastModified.description: When the discount was last modified (ISO-8601).

isDeleted.description: Whether the discount has been soft-deleted. Deleted discounts are only returned when explicitly requested via includeDeleted.

DiscountDto.description: A discount defined by the merchant that can be applied to orders or line items.

chargeId.description: Optional UUID for the new charge; generated by the server when omitted.

chargeAmountType.description: How the amount is interpreted: PERCENTAGE (percentage of the item price) or FIXED (absolute amount).

amount.description: Charge value — percentage points (scaled by 100, e.g. 725 = 7.25%) for PERCENTAGE charges, or the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents) for FIXED charges. Must be at least 0.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp (ISO-8601). Defaults to the server time when omitted.

lastModified.description: Modification timestamp (ISO-8601). Defaults to the server time when omitted.

isDefault.description: Whether the charge is applied by default to items that opt into the merchant's default charges.

ThirdPartyChargeCreateDto.description: Payload for creating a new charge (tax or extra fee).

categoryId.description: Optional UUID for the new category; generated by the server when omitted.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp (ISO-8601). Defaults to the server time when omitted.

lastModified.description: Modification timestamp (ISO-8601). Defaults to the server time when omitted.

ThirdPartyCategoryCreateDto.description: Payload for creating a new inventory category.

entry.description: How the card was entered (e.g. swipe, chip, contactless), if paid by card.

amount.description: Amount of the transaction, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

transactionId.description: Unique UUID identifier of the transaction.

orderId.description: UUID of the order this transaction belongs to, if any.

refNumber.description: Reference number of the transaction as printed on the receipt.

transactionType.description: Kind of transaction (e.g. SALE, REFUND, VOID).

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used (e.g. CASH, CREDIT, DEBIT, EBT).

taxAmount.description: Tax portion of the amount, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

cardType.description: Card brand used for the payment (e.g. VISA, MASTERCARD), if paid by card.

rawData.description: Raw response data returned by the payment terminal, if any.

takenBy.description: Name of the person who took the payment, if recorded.

authCode.description: Authorization code returned by the payment processor, if paid by card.

hostRefNumber.description: Reference number assigned by the payment host, if paid by card.

aid.description: EMV application identifier (AID) of the card, if paid by chip card.

appLabel.description: EMV application label of the card, if paid by chip card.

tenderedAmount.description: Amount tendered by the customer, in the smallest currency unit; used for cash payments.

changeAmount.description: Change returned to the customer, in the smallest currency unit; used for cash payments.

refundedTransactionId.description: UUID of the transaction that was refunded by this one, for REFUND transactions.

dualPricingSurchargeApplied.description: Whether a dual-pricing card surcharge was applied to this transaction.

cardNumber.description: Masked card number used for the payment, if paid by card.

TransactionDto.description: A payment transaction recorded in CorePOS (sale, refund, etc.). Monetary amounts are in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

id.description: Unique UUID identifier of the merchant.

state.description: State or province of the merchant's address.

zip.description: Postal (ZIP) code of the merchant's address.

ownerEmail.description: Email address of the merchant's owner account.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone number of the merchant.

MerchantThirdPartyDto.description: Merchant (store) information as exposed to third-party applications.

appId.description: Unique UUID identifier of the application.

isInTrial.description: Whether the merchant is currently in the application's free trial period.

billingStartTime.description: When billing started for this merchant and application (ISO-8601).

status.description: Current billing status of the application for this merchant.

daysLapsed.description: Number of days elapsed since billing started.

availableSubscriptions.description: All subscription plans the application offers.

AppBillingInfoDto.description: Billing status of a third-party application for a merchant, including the current and available subscription plans.

id.description: Unique UUID identifier of the subscription plan.

name.description: Display name of the subscription plan.

amount.description: Price of the plan, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

description.description: Human-readable description of what the plan includes.

isActive.description: Whether the plan is currently offered.

AppSubscriptionDto.description: A subscription plan offered by a third-party application.

percentage.description: Percentage difference between card and cash prices (e.g. 3.5 means card prices are 3.5% higher). At most 4, with up to two decimal places.

applyToDebit.description: Whether the dual-pricing surcharge also applies to debit card payments.

DualPricingSettingDto.description: The merchant's dual-pricing configuration — the difference between card and cash prices.

bearerAuth.description: Use your JWT Bearer token in the 'Authorization' header. Example: 'Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI…'
